verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a developer-facing MCP server that lets external AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) interact with the Embedded Payroll API for building integrations — this is a dev-tooling integration, not a built-in AI assistant inside the Gusto product for end users to delegate payroll/HR tasks. No evidence of an in-app AI assistant, chat interface, or agentic feature for end users.
